<translate>
<!--T:5-->
The '''Bioman''' is a variant of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Saibamen|Saibamen]] that lives in the snowy biomes of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. It hunts in small groups and, unlike a Saibaman, never grabs you to blow itself up.
</translate>

<translate>
== Spawning == <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
Bioman spawn in snowy biomes (every biome in the <code>#forge:is_snowy</code> tag, such as Snowy Plains) in groups of 2–4, with spawn weight 60. Like the Saibamen, they spawn as monsters: not in Peaceful, only in dim spots (block light 7 or less), and only about a third of spawn attempts succeed. In Creative, the '''Bioman Spawn Egg''' spawns one.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior == <!--T:8-->

<!--T:9-->
The Bioman attacks on sight and fights on the '''Novice''' AI tier (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]). It has a little less health and damage than a Saibaman but moves faster, shrugs off half of the knockback it takes, and has a Battle Power of 1,100. Unlike the Saibamen, it '''never self-destructs'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
The Bioman drops nothing.
</translate>
